acceptance_cases.counterexample: An inner occurrence claim stores a downstream root and makes its canonical preimage recursive.
acceptance_cases.given: The exact local occurrence claim is nested inside OwnedSettlementV2.
acceptance_cases.invariant: No value inside the settlement depends on a root derived after the settlement.
nonclaims: Acyclicity does not authenticate the settlement.
This case does not authorize a codec implementation.
acceptance_cases.then: Every downstream field and backward dependency edge rejects.
acceptance_cases.title: Settlement-root dependency remains acyclic
acceptance_cases.when: The dependency graph and inner-claim field registry are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A command-derived occurrence ID is stored inside the settlement that the command root commits.
acceptance_cases.given: The exact authenticated command commits the settlement and intent tuple.
acceptance_cases.invariant: Occurrence IDs are derived from command root and settlement fill ordinals only after command identity exists.
nonclaims: The exact V2 command schema remains a later checkpoint.
An occurrence ID carries no state authority.
acceptance_cases.then: The inner occurrence-ID field and every command-root cycle reject.
acceptance_cases.title: Occurrence identity remains downstream
acceptance_cases.when: The inner registry and dependency graph are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A root projection omits local claims, allowing unequal settlements to share one identity.
acceptance_cases.given: OwnedSettlementV2 contains one exact ordered occurrence-claim tuple.
acceptance_cases.invariant: The full canonical settlement envelope includes the complete ordered local claim tuple.
nonclaims: Hash commitment does not establish semantic correctness.
SHA-256 collision resistance is assumed.
acceptance_cases.then: Every omission, blanking, or separate-body projection rejects.
acceptance_cases.title: Settlement root commits the complete claim tuple
acceptance_cases.when: The root strategy and outer field registry are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A B1A-valid configuration with root H_OTHER is replayed while the exact pre-state header commits H_GOOD.
acceptance_cases.given: B1A validation and exact-state authority are distinct stages.
acceptance_cases.invariant: Only the fresh binder output from exact pre-state and validated claim may enter replay or batch construction.
nonclaims: The state-bound configuration type is not implemented here.
Binding to a historical exact state does not establish store currentness.
acceptance_cases.then: Root, deployment, and activation mismatches reject before replay.
acceptance_cases.title: B1A-valid configuration is rebound to exact state
acceptance_cases.when: The state-binding laws and graph predecessors are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A caller substitutes an internally consistent local claim tuple and recomputes all outer roots.
acceptance_cases.given: The command, current pre-state, state-bound configuration, context, settlement, and intents remain present.
acceptance_cases.invariant: Admitted and freshly replayed tuples produce one exact controlled claim tuple.
nonclaims: The current replay kernel remains unmounted.
This case does not prove datastore atomicity.
acceptance_cases.then: Coordinated claim and root substitution rejects before occurrence identity.
acceptance_cases.title: One controlled claim tuple is source-bound
acceptance_cases.when: The two tuple predecessors and fresh replay sources are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A shell selects pre-state, configuration, command, settlement, or context roots independently.
acceptance_cases.given: Every derived digest retains its exact independently sourced value.
acceptance_cases.invariant: Submitted roots are equality targets and never construction authority.
nonclaims: The exact authentication mechanisms remain later checkpoints.
Canonical bytes alone create no authority.
acceptance_cases.then: Deleting any exact-source edge or promoting a submitted root rejects.
acceptance_cases.title: Independent sources remain present through binding
acceptance_cases.when: The source roles and graph fan-in are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: Positive-fee witnesses after zero-fee fills are renumbered to contiguous claim indexes.
acceptance_cases.given: Settlement fill ordinals may be sparse in the positive-fee claim tuple.
acceptance_cases.invariant: Claims retain strictly increasing original settlement fill ordinals and occurrence IDs use those ordinals.
nonclaims: The existing V1 SLNF contiguous-position adapter is not promoted.
A future V2 normal form remains unimplemented.
acceptance_cases.then: Renumbering, duplicate, out-of-range, zero-fee, missing-positive, or reordered claims reject.
acceptance_cases.title: Sparse settlement fill identity is preserved
acceptance_cases.when: The ordinal and cardinality policy is checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: An earlier failure leaves a replay candidate, controlled tuple, occurrence IDs, witness batch, or later authority.
acceptance_cases.given: Decode, admission, binding, replay, equality, and derivation are ordered phases.
acceptance_cases.invariant: Every rejection before controlled derivation carries no intermediate or downstream authority-like output.
nonclaims: Committed-failure semantics are outside this checkpoint.
No publication shell is implemented.
acceptance_cases.then: The expanded no-successor output registry remains exact and closed.
acceptance_cases.title: Early rejection is authority-empty

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A separately supplied consumed tuple diverges after admitted/replayed equality.
acceptance_cases.given: The admitted and recomputed tuples are the only tuple inputs.
acceptance_cases.invariant: Equality produces one exact controlled tuple and no consumed tuple is independently supplied.
nonclaims: The controlled tuple is a design value only.
No allocator is authorized by this relation.
acceptance_cases.then: Any third loose tuple, post-equality filter, reorder, aggregation, or substitution rejects.
acceptance_cases.title: Loose consumed-tuple surface is eliminated
acceptance_cases.when: The exact controlled tuple node and edge set are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A normalizer reads a copied tuple or enumerates the positive-fee subset.
acceptance_cases.given: The controlled batch owns exactly one controlled claim tuple.
acceptance_cases.invariant: The V2 normal-form boundary consumes only the tuple projected from the exact controlled batch.
nonclaims: The V2 normalizer is not implemented.
The current V1 SLNF remains research evidence only.
acceptance_cases.then: A direct loose-tuple-to-normal-form edge or re-enumeration policy rejects.
acceptance_cases.title: Downstream consumption follows the batch-owned tuple
acceptance_cases.when: The batch projection and downstream source rule are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: The controlled batch duplicates roots, versions, or language identifiers beside their exact source values.
acceptance_cases.given: Every duplicated fact is derivable from one nested exact source.
acceptance_cases.invariant: The batch constructor stores only nested exact sources, controlled claims, and occurrence IDs.
nonclaims: Derived properties still require point-of-use revalidation later.
The exact batch-root preimage remains a later checkpoint.
acceptance_cases.then: Every independently swappable duplicate field rejects.
acceptance_cases.title: Controlled batch uses the smaller nested construction
acceptance_cases.when: The controlled and forbidden batch-field registries are checked.

acceptance_cases.counterexample: A design revision is treated as permission to implement or mount V2 settlement authority.
acceptance_cases.given: Carrier literals, scalar schemas, root preimages, and rejection codes remain under review.
nonclaims: No V2 settlement carrier is implemented.
No state, transition, receipt, bundle, proof, publication, or datastore path is approved.
acceptance_cases.then: Implementation and mount authority remain false.
acceptance_cases.title: Design evidence cannot promote runtime authority
acceptance_cases.when: The phase flags and nonclaim set are checked.

nonclaims: Revision 2 implements no OwnedSettlementV2 carrier or canonical codec.
The state-bound active configuration and controlled witness batch are not implemented.
The current V1 SLNF adapter is not a conforming V2 sparse-ordinal consumer.
The exact V2 command schema and root preimage are not frozen.
No state, configuration, transition, receipt, bundle, proof, publication, datastore, or mount authority exists.
Python and Rust parity is not established.

source_roles.downstream_claim_consumption: only the exact tuple nested in the controlled witness batch
source_roles.state_bound_active_configuration_v2: fresh binder output from the exact pre-state and B1A-validated claim
source_roles.validated_active_configuration_claim_v2: B1A-valid content with no state authority before binding
